description:
Billionaire Google co-founder and ex-California resident Sergey Brin has said he’s adamantly opposed to a proposed one-time, 5% tax on the wealth of California residents (and has spent $57 million to fight it) because he fears it will lead the state down a similar socialist path as that of the former Soviet Union, which his family fled when he was 6 years old.

author: Forbes
description:
Are you implementing AI to solve a problem, or just adding technology to a broken workflow? Forbes' Maggie McGrath sits down with Teresa Barreira, Chief Marketing and Communications Officer at Publicis Sapient, to discuss the dangers of committing "random acts of AI." Teresa shares how her team successfully automated 80% of their daily tasks by building over 100 custom AI assistants—allowing her workforce to focus on the 20% of high-value work that only humans can do.

author: Forbes
description:
Being an entrepreneur is very important," says the one and only Porsha Williams (@Porsha4Real), adding that beyond #RHOA, her businesses take center stage. "When you have a dream or you have an idea, you build off of it."
This week on #ForbesTalksShop, Williams—entrepreneur, television personality and best-selling author—joins host Kim Peiffer (@PeifferK1) to talk about the origins and evolution of her companies, @GoNakedHair and @PamperedByPorsha.

From starring on @BravoTV's 'Real Housewives Of Atlanta' to starting a business in the wake of her divorce, Williams opens up about her entrepreneurial spirit and shares the tools and routines that help her balance life as a business owner, reality TV star and mother. :movie_camera: Watch the full interview on Forbes YT Channel

author: Forbes
description:
Porsha Williams is building far more than a reality TV legacy—she’s building a business empire.

On this episode of Forbes Talks Shop, the entrepreneur and Real Housewives of Atlanta star sits down with Kim Peiffer to break down how she turned personal reinvention into multiple thriving brands, including her $10M+ hair company Go Naked Hair and her fast-growing lifestyle line Pampered by Porsha.

From launching a business after divorce to selling directly on TikTok Shop, Porsha shares how she connects with customers, builds trust and scales with intention. She also opens up about confidence, entrepreneurship, and why she believes she’s on track to become a billionaire.

Plus, she gets real about her nighttime routine, self-care habits, travel must-haves and the one product she still swears by (hint: it costs less than you think).

title: Porsha Williams On Building A $10M Hair Brand & Expanding Her Business Empire

description:

Miguel also reveals learnings about himself during the making of his fifth studio album, Caos. In addition, he discusses fatherhood and explains his passion for investing in Black and Brown creators.
